0022600204.text: The Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East) enter their 11th game of the season on a six-game losing streak, with a 2-4 home record, while the Cavaliers (5-5, 7th in the East) have lost their last game and are 4-2 on the road. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (out, groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate is day-to-day with a quadriceps issue, while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (out, elbow) and Jarrett Allen is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and they fell 118-113 to Cleveland in their last meeting in Charlotte on February 20, 2026, with no games between the teams yet this season.
